extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3. Whole country chapter read (abstract, pillars I to IV, annexes), with a keyword search for technology terms. Excluded under rules 0.4 and the analyst guidance: court and prosecution case management (ACCMIS and the prosecution case management system), court IT equipment and staffing, audio and video recording of hearings, publication of court rulings and other documents on websites, the State Commission for Prevention of Corruption's software, asset declaration system and database interoperability (back-office or enforcement systems), cybercrime units, and online media regulation and online harassment of journalists (media content, not technology). General claims on the digitalisation of the judiciary and the body that steers it are extracted with theme_doubtful for the analyst to decide. No Chapter 2 material. No period covered is stated in the register or the document (only the ECHR cut-off date), so period_covered is null. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
